method.input: Explicit chunk IDs from previously adjudicated Gate 2 micro-lots.

batches.observed_signal: Tori and Stallings evidence have distinct source IDs, documents, and authors, so their pair receives no shared-provenance or near-duplicate signal. Pairwise comparisons among Stallings items report shared source provenance; this is a broad review cue, not a duplicate judgment.

For SYN-015, the complete page-373 passage and its two fragment extractions produce three shared-source, overlapping-page review pairs. Text ratios are 0.2201, 0.2376, and 0.4585, below the near-duplicate threshold; provenance, rather than text similarity, surfaces the known overlap. SYN-016 has no p373 fragments in its qrels and no overlapping-page pair.

Each query has the two same-source, same-page pairs corresponding to full chunks and alternate page-fragment IDs. In both pairs the document IDs differ, but source ID and page overlap identify the provenance review cue.

evidence_ids: Operating Systems - Internals and Design Principles 7th.pdf:p760:c0000

batches.observed_signal: Each query reports shared source/document provenance among the three Seguridad en Redes passages. The shared origin prompts review but does not imply they are duplicate passages or semantically equivalent. Kurose's distinct-source networking metaphor receives no duplicate-like signal.

interpretation.usefulness: Provenance signals surfaced same-source clusters, including known same-page extraction overlap even when internal document IDs differ. Different-source complementary SYN-014 passages were not conflated.
interpretation.near_duplicate_detection: No real micro-lot pair crossed both configured text-similarity and SimHash thresholds. The known page-373 and dup2 extraction overlaps were still surfaced through provenance, not classified as text near-duplicates.
interpretation.false_discard_check: No signal changes relevance grades, source independence, complementarity, sufficiency, or qrel inclusion/exclusion. The diagnostic output produces no qrel actions and keeps human adjudication explicit.
limitations: REVIEW_SHARED_PROVENANCE is intentionally broad: same source alone can trigger it across distant pages.
These four selected micro-lots do not establish corpus-wide precision or recall for duplicate detection.
Text-similarity thresholds are review defaults, not validated decision cutoffs.
The pair counts repeat evidence comparisons across related query variants.
